match_shape_3d — 3D match_localize op

• Data kinds: voxel × voxel → position

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.match_shape_3d(vol, template, device='cpu', mc=0.05, subvoxel=True) (to call the implementation directly, import match3d; match3d.match_shape_3d(vol, template, device='cpu', mc=0.05, subvoxel=True); from the registry, ops3d.get("match_shape_3d"))

• Return value through the ledger: fullseye.ledger.match_shape_3d(...) returns only the declared out type position (the underlying function also returns auxiliary values). When you need what was dropped, use fullseye.ledger.match_shape_3d.raw(...) or call match3d.match_shape_3d directly.

• GPU: this op has a GPU path (device="cuda")

Usage

3-D shape-based (gradient-orientation) matching = the voxel version of the 2-D shapematch_gpu ("contour matching").

The sum of dot products of unit gradient vectors of template and scene (Steger style). Invariant to intensity/contrast, it measures the match by edges/shape. score(pos)=Σ<û_scene(pos+dt), û_model(dt)>/n, computed with conv3d over 3 components.

Procedure: sobel3d on both volumes → only voxels whose magnitude exceeds mc are made unit vectors (the rest are 0). The 3 components of the template's unit gradient are used as kernels, conv3d is applied component-wise to the scene's unit gradient and summed, and the result is divided by the number of valid template voxels n. The score is in [−1, 1]: 1 is a perfect match (all gradient directions aligned), and −1 under contrast inversion.

• mc: threshold on the raw output (32 times the true gradient) of sobel3d. The smaller it is, the more noise gradients from flat regions

enter the vote.

• Position: the coordinates of the return value [score, z, y, x] (float64 array) are where in the scene the template centre voxel (index T//2)

lands. Positions where the template does not fit entirely are set to 0, so if the template is larger than the scene everything stays 0 and index (0,0,0) is returned (no exception).

• subvoxel=True refines to the centroid of the positive scores in the ±2 neighbourhood of the argmax (accel_match._subvoxel_com).

Downstream: refine_translation_lk (corner convention, so subtract T//2) / refine_lm. It is not invariant to rotation (align the rotation first with match_logpolar_z).
